articles.title: Hackers Used Meta’s AI Support Bot to Seize Instagram Accounts
articles.summary: Microsoft drops a 200-bug bomb on Patch Tuesday, with 36 critical vulns ready to ruin someone's day. AI-assisted vuln hunting is making admins cry into their coffee worldwide.

articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Hackers tricked Meta's 'AI support assistant' into hijacking Obama's Instagram and the Space Force Chief's accounts. When your chatbot becomes the insider threat, maybe it's time to rethink automation.

articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: CISA contractor casually dumps AWS GovCloud keys and agency secrets on GitHub like it's a mixtape. Congress is big mad about America's cybersecurity watchdog leaking like a broken fire hydrant.

articles.title: Tell Congress: Just Say No to NO FAKES
articles.summary: Multiple states want to ban kids from social media entirely under the guise of 'safety.' Because nothing protects children like censorship wrapped in moral panic.

articles.title: Chrome's zero-day Whac-A-Mole continues with fifth exploited bug of the year
articles.summary: Signal warns UK's nude-scanning surveillance plan 'endangers us all' because device-level backdoors never stay limited to their original purpose. Today's think-of-the-children becomes tomorrow's political censorship.

articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5, Its Most Powerful AI Yet, With Cyber Safeguards
articles.summary: Chrome's fifth zero-day of the year gets patched after active exploitation. Google paid the researcher $55K for finding what their own security team missed.

articles.title: Six Proto6 Vulnerabilities in protobuf.js Expose Node.js Apps to RCE and DoS
articles.summary: Anonymous researcher 'Chaotic Eclipse' drops RoguePlanet, a Microsoft Defender race condition that grants SYSTEM access. When your antivirus becomes the virus, chaos truly reigns.

articles.title: Mythos Preview can weaponize N-day vulnerabilities in hours
articles.summary: Check Point's VPN auth bypass gets weaponized by Qilin ransomware crew in active attacks. Your secure remote access just became someone else's front door.

articles.title: Google patches fifth Chrome zero-day of the year alongside Android fixes
articles.summary: Anthropic's Mythos Preview can weaponize N-day vulns in hours instead of weeks. AI is democratizing exploit development - for better or worse, probably worse.

articles.title: Proposal: Add separate oss-security-vulnerability-reports mailing list (for AI vulnpocalypse)
articles.summary: CISA gives feds 72 hours to patch Check Point VPN zero-day after Qilin ransomware starts party-crashing government networks. Emergency patching: because Monday mornings weren't stressful enough.
